undefined_conditions: The locked source returns a non-finite result for an otherwise requested scope.

randomness.notes: The seed controls the locked source's pandas subsampling when a table exceeds 50,000 rows; it is still recorded for smaller tables.

normalization.function: identity because the source score is already bounded similarity

failure_contribution_policy.mathematically_undefined: Zero weight; preserve state and denominator coverage.
failure_contribution_policy.insufficient_support: Zero weight; preserve state and denominator coverage.
failure_contribution_policy.not_applicable: Zero weight; preserve state and denominator coverage.
failure_contribution_policy.implementation_failure: Zero weight; mark the run partial and preserve failure evidence.
failure_contribution_policy.resource_failure: Zero weight; mark the run partial and preserve failure evidence.

reference_fixtures: mixed numerical, categorical, boolean, and datetime fixture
unresolved_limitations: P2 is diagnostic until the protocol and Dataset Profiles pass later release gates.

admission.reason: Source parity is validated, but protocol freeze and release approval are later gates.

records.description: Per-column KSComplement for numerical/datetime data and TVComplement for categorical/boolean data, averaged over finite source results.

aggregation.rule: Arithmetic mean of all finite evaluated column scores; unsupported types remain explicit not_applicable Atomic Results.

records.description: Per-pair CorrelationSimilarity or ContingencySimilarity with the locked Quality Report contribution thresholds.

aggregation.rule: Arithmetic mean of finite pair scores meeting the locked real correlation (>0.5) or association (>0.3) threshold; other computed pairs are retained at zero weight.
